explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list for dexmedetomidine hydrochloride injection has been current since 2020-04-10 and includes multiple manufacturers; no public FDA signal at our plants

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows dexmedetomidine hydrochloride injection as Current with an initial posting date of 2020-04-10 and an update date of 2026-09-15 for Accord Healthcare Inc. citing discontinuation of manufacture.

Additional manufacturers on the Current list include Amneal Pharmaceuticals (update 2026-10-06), Azurity Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (update 2026-10-15), Baxter Healthcare (update 2026-10-16), Eugia US LLC (update 2026-10-19), Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (update 2026-10-15), Gland Pharma Limited (update 2026-07-22), Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. (update 2026-10-14), HQ Specialty Pharma (update 2026-10-01), Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co. (US Agent eVenus Pharmaceutical Laboratories, Inc.) (update 2026-10-14), Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. (update 2026-10-05), and Meitheal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (update 2026-08-27).
As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 78 months.
Our supply of the 100 ug/mL, 2 mL vial (NDC 0143-9532-25) is labeled Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. at both Corvale East and Corvale General.
Corvale East holds 59 vials at 7.1 per day for 8.3 days on hand; Corvale General holds 159 vials at 7.7 per day for 20.6 days on hand.
The recommended action is to transfer 41 vials of 100 ug/mL, 2 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would leave Corvale General with 15 days and bring Corvale East to 14 days.

rejected.text: There is no public FDA inspection classification (OAI, VAI, or NAI) or other public FDA signal reported for the plants supplying our sites.
